description: Main window: the app-drawn title bar (WIN-7.1) drags, minimizes, maximizes and closes it; links open in the browser through the opener plugin (WIN-7.3); agent signals post toasts through the notification plugin (WIN-7.7); Open Project picks a folder through the dialog plugin, and local files open in their default app or in Explorer through the opener plugin (WIN-8.15). The updater plugin (WIN-10.3) gets no permission here: the app's own updater_* commands check, download and install, so an install always passes the release-key check and stops Point Guard and the daemon first.
